title: Imp Jar & Lucky 13 Blue Raspberry & Strawberry Ice Blast 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blue Raspberry & Strawberry Ice Blast by Imp Jar and Lucky 13 unleashes a frosty wave of flavour, combining the tartness of blue raspberry with the sweetness of ripe strawberries, all enveloped in an icy blast. This e-liquid delivers a refreshing and vibrant vape, perfect for those who enjoy a balance of sweet and sour with a cooling finish. The icy sensation enhances the fruit flavours, providing a crisp and exhilarating vaping experience. This enticing flavour is part of an exciting series from the collaboration between Imp Jar and Lucky 13, known for their innovative and beloved e-liquid creations. This partnership combines the best of both worlds: Lucky 13's flair for capturing authentic flavours with Imp Jar’s versatile 50/50 formulation, making these e-liquids suitable for a wide array of devices, from pod kits to starter kits. The 50PG/50VG ratio in these shortfill bottles offers compatibility beyond sub-ohm devices, extending to MTL vape kits with different coil resistances. With 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an extra 10ml space for a 10ml nicotine shot, these shortfills give vapers complete control over their experience. Add a single 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot to create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, tailored just to your liking. Imp Jar’s collaboration with Lucky 13 not only brings innovative flavours but also offers a practical and economical alternative to smaller bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid, ensuring your favourite tastes last even longer.
